entries.en: The harbour's SAR team searched the bay until the missing sailor was found.
entries.zh: 港口的搜救队一直在海湾搜寻，直到找到那名失踪的水手。

entries.en: We rested in the shade of a kop before continuing across the South African plain.
entries.zh: 我们在一座小山的阴影里休息后，继续穿越南非的平原。

entries.meaningZh: 米尔（沙俄时代的一种村社组织）
entries.en: In the novel set in tsarist Russia, the mir sent two villagers to speak to the landowner.
entries.zh: 在这部以沙俄为背景的小说中，米尔村社派了两名村民去与地主交谈。

entries.meaningZh: 每加仑汽油能行驶的英里数
entries.en: Our petrol car averaged 32 mpg on the drive to the coast.
entries.zh: 我们的汽油车在开往海岸的途中，平均每加仑汽油行驶了32英里。

entries.en: The child paused beside a small statue of Bes in the Egyptian gallery.
entries.zh: 孩子在埃及展厅里的一尊贝斯小雕像旁停下了脚步。

entries.en: Dr Liu returned to the laboratory to collect the notebook.
entries.zh: 刘博士回到实验室去取那本笔记本。

entries.en: Vaz moved the easel closer to the window to get more light.
entries.zh: 瓦斯把画架移到更靠近窗户的地方，以获得更多光线。

entries.en: The chair postponed item XXX until all the committee members had arrived.
entries.zh: 主席把第三十项议程推迟到所有委员会成员到齐后再讨论。

entries.en: The factory's CHP system supplied electricity and recovered heat for the drying room.
entries.zh: 工厂的热电联合系统供应电力，并回收热量供干燥室使用。

entries.en: The bookseller sent the catalogue ppd, so I owed nothing for postage when it arrived.
entries.zh: 书商寄来的目录邮费已付，因此送达时我无需另付邮费。

entries.en: We played bao on the veranda until it grew too dark to see the board.
entries.zh: 我们在游廊上玩非洲石子棋，直到天太黑，看不清棋盘。

entries.en: The two governments negotiated an MFN clause before signing the trade agreement.
entries.zh: 两国政府在签署贸易协定前商谈了一项最惠国条款。

entries.en: At the French-language seminar, questions about the FMI kept the discussion going past lunch.
entries.zh: 在那场法语研讨会上，关于国际货币基金组织的问题使讨论一直持续到午饭后。

entries.en: The old Scottish estate map marked the cottage and its garden as a separate feu.
entries.zh: 那张旧苏格兰庄园地图把小屋及其花园标作一块独立的封地。

entries.en: The comedian's exaggerated bow drew a loud yok from someone behind us.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员夸张的鞠躬引得我们身后的某个人发出一阵响亮的大笑。

entries.en: Moy put the spare key in an envelope and handed it to the caretaker.
entries.zh: 莫伊把备用钥匙放进一个信封，交给了管理员。
